title: The Ink Debt of the Scriptorium
story: Morrowquill the Ledger Bat hangs from the scriptorium rafters, refusing to return the monks' inkpots until an old debt balances. "Each pot costs the same," it screeches, "and 9 pots plus a 14-coin cart fee came to 122 coins."
question: How many coins does one inkpot cost?
hint: Peel off the 14-coin cart fee first, then split what's left among the 9 pots.
victory: Mr 6 chalks the answer on the wall so neatly that Morrowquill checks it twice, squeaks "balanced," and hangs the inkpots back on their hooks before flapping off to audit somebody else.
imagePrompt: A bat with parchment wings and tiny spectacles hanging over rows of inkpots in a candlelit scriptorium, a small number-six knight writing figures on a slate.
